description: This file defines an abstract class 'CardStreamAnimator' which specifies various methods for creating object animations for UI views in a card stream layout, including initial, appearing, disappearing, swipe-in, and swipe-out animations. It also includes a nested static class 'EmptyAnimator' which provides a no-operation implementation of these methods.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator
classes.description: An abstract class which defines animators for CardStreamLinearLayout.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator.EmptyAnimator
classes.description: A simple implementation of CardStreamAnimator used to turn animations off.

methods.name: setSpeedFactor
methods.description: Set the speed factor of animations. Higher value means longer duration & slow animation.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Define initial animation for each child when rotating a screen.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Define disappearing animation for a child when a view is removed programmatically.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Define appearing animation for a child when a view is added programmatically.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Define swipe-in animation when a view is not moved enough to be removed.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Define swipe-out animation when a view is removed by a swipe action.
